==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number" and "story name" with the appropriate information.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Journal|''ISSUE NUMBER''|STORY NAME|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}

*'''Note''': Formatted name is ''only'' needed when the episode name includes either italicization, or intentional parentheses. Otherwise, it should be excluded, as parenthetical descriptors are natively hidden.
*For stories reprinted in other media, use <code>|reprint=1</code> in Appearances sections.
